positions.title: Structures & Load Electronics Team Lead
positions.description:
Structures Team Lead – designed floating foundation, ballast, and mooring to meet hydrodynamic stability and installation constraints.
- Floating Foundation: Open truss of 30 × 30 mm 80/20 aluminum; fits 61 × 122 cm door, carries turbine stem via CNC-machined flange.
- Buoyancy: ten EVA boards + two vinyl buoys; ballast cage beneath waterline positions CM 30 cm below CB, ensuring positive hydrostatic stability.
- Mooring: four cam-buckle lines — tool-less, repeatable setup, watch-circle ≤ 50 cm.

Load-Electronics Sub-Team Lead – created adaptive resistive load bank and control firmware to maximize power extraction. 
- Topology: three series “blocks” (1 + 1 + 10 power resistors) with MOSFET-switched parallel/series paths; relay bypass for coarse steps.
- Range & Resolution: 1.9 Ω → 40 Ω in ≈ 0.2 Ω increments; aluminum heat-sink mounting.
- Control Algorithm: Arduino MEGA firmware computes ΔV/ΔI to match generator impedance in real time (one-hot gate drive).
- Design Automation: custom script optimizes resistor values/combinations for linear step size and minimal part count.

positions.title: President
positions.description:
•	Directed club operations and supervised recruiting, finances, and outreach with other board members.
•	Recruited a team to launch a new Combat Robotics division to expand and bring growth to the club.
•	Instructed a boot camp on Altium designer to familiarize members with industry-standard PCB CAD.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Leadership · Altium Designer · Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Design · Robotics

positions.title: Avionics Subsystem Team Member
positions.description:
•	2nd Place at the 2022 FAR 51025 Rocketry Competition 10K in California.
•	Charted a rocket tracker in C++ utilizing GPS, gyroscope, and altitude data from the rocket to trace flight trajectory with 99.3% accuracy to point a helix antenna at the projectile—the Physical mount was devised with SOLIDWORKS.
•	Programmed an algorithm to process GPS, gyroscope, and altitude data with C++ to trace the trajectory of the rocket in flight with 99.3% accuracy.

company.name: AstroJays - The Johns Hopkins Rocketry Team

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description:
Interned here during the summers of 2022 and 2023. 
Charted a secure access system for 12 manufacturing machines for student/faculty use.
•	Developed a .NET Windows application for machine shop safety to restrict access to authorized users while automating various administrative tasks. Featuring a user-friendly GUI created using WPF in C#, enabling users to unlock different machines and administrators to monitor the entire system efficiently with a swipe of a valid school ID.
•	Designed a PostgreSQL database to handle user, invoice, budget, and machine data while managing data relationships.
•	Launched an HTTP server in Python to establish communications within the access system network and handle client requests for authentication, machine management, user registration, etc. Incorporated automated billing and data usage visualization tools in Python to improve administrative efficiency.
•	Built a robust C# back-end to manage machine access, employing a custom communication protocol with the server and utilizing an Arduino microcontroller to regulate the state of each machine autonomously.
•	Designed and debugged schematics for a 220V power switch controlled by an Arduino Nano utilizing I2C communication with the master to coordinate power interruptions and display indicator lights with machine status information for user safety.
Pioneered design efforts for a manufacturing device for hybrid nanofiber suture
•	Created a software interface to control the device’s motors, applying a Kalman Filter on encoder data to meet RPM requirements based on ambient conditions measured through sensors and specific nanofiber properties at 99.6% accuracy. 
•	Fabricated an auto balancer to offset imbalances due to moving parts and maintain steady operations at 4000+ RPM.
•	Prepared the design for high volume manufacturing by using standardized hardware and electronics.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · .NET Framework · C (Programming Language) · Project Management · MATLAB · C++ · WPF Development · SQL · PostgreSQL · Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Design · Robotics · Arduino

projects.title: 74 Series Logic Design Projects
projects.description:
•	Designed and implemented a digital version of the 1900s classic game Skee Ball. A final design project for Digital Systems Fundamentals.
•	Redesigned and built the classic Atari Pong game. Implemented an industry-standard 640x480@60hz graphics card. Done over the summer for personal enjoyment and to broaden my knowledge of digital logic.

projects.title: Real-Time Detection of Irregularities on the Road
projects.description:
•	Reduced road hazards by using object detection of irregularities on the road with YOLOv4. Reached a mAP@0.50 of 42.63%.
•	Analyzed and formatted a dataset of over 20 000 images using Python, Matplotlib, NumPy, and PILLOW for proper computer vision model training.
